{{Quote|Bartender, set this guy up with another Vlizz-kick!|A Quarren|<ref name="Death in the Undercity">''[[Death in the Undercity]]''</ref>}}
'''Vlizz-kick''' was a drink favored by members of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was fermented from [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], vlizz-kick could be purchased from the [[Long Drink]], a bar that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Morjanssik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].
